fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-20 around 12:10 hrs, it was reported that Rakesh Krishnan was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Anbu Colony Highway Junction in Karur. The complaint was lodged by Bharath Prakash (9000000118) on behalf of Rakesh Krishnan, whose contact number is given as 9000000381. The complaint mentions Eswari Raj, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000433, in connection with the events. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly pushed the victim during a street argument.
